minimal_missing_fact.kind: one passive PTE service episode in the existing legal A8/gap0 normal workload, selected independently of positive debt
minimal_missing_fact.core: At the selected PTE P actual MIG AR acceptance edge tP, record every already accepted predecessor payload remaining R-beat debt after same-edge Rfire, then its resolution through P.firstRVALID and P.firstRfire. K may be zero; the episode must not be chosen retrospectively because K>0.
minimal_missing_fact.sampling_point: Genesys2 top s_axi_ar*/s_axi_r* immediately at i_ddr AXI64 input/output after i_xlnx_axi_clock_converter_ddr, clock ddr_clock_out == i_ddr.ui_clk. Keep native cycle unit; UI Hz not newly established.
minimal_missing_fact.debt_definition: For each predecessor payload occurrence j accepted before P: k_j(tP)=ARLEN_j+1 - cumulative associated RVALID&&RREADY handshakes through and including edge tP; K_payload=sum(k_j). Decrement same-edge L R fire before snapshot. P accepted at tP contributes no predecessor debt. Choose one L with k_j>0 as witness; keep all predecessor owners to avoid falsely calling CPU/DDTW debt payload.
minimal_fields: PTE waiting owner: DID, TL channel/type, owner generation/cookie, PTW level/stage and PTE address/occurrence
payload L owner: DMA port/DID, descriptor generation and burst occurrence
MIG accepted AR sequence/edge, full6-bit ARID, address30, ARLEN, ARSIZE, ARBURST, classification
MIG R event edge, full6-bit RID, RVALID/RREADY/RLAST/RRESP and per-occurrence consumed beat count
PTE tARaccepted, tFirstRVALID, tFirstRfire; L tARaccepted,tLastRfire; debt snapshot after same-edge R fire
source-clock owner-to-MIG association proof and reset/calibration/error/window flags
known-quiet ARM/epoch proof; complete fixed-window eligible PTE opportunity count, selected ordinal, coverage, and explicit no-record reason
minimal_missing_fact.record_grammar: A single bounded event record can retain ordered accepted-AR ledger, R-fire rows and held-R intervals until P.firstRfire/receipt; no complete workload matrix or bank-state monitor is required for this fact.
minimal_missing_fact.required_correlation: Full ID denotes a source/local ID, not a unique transaction. Use epoch plus accepted ordinal/per-RID FIFO occurrence. Correlate source owner to destination using ordered endpoint tuples/full ID/addr[29:0]/len/size/burst and generation; ambiguous repeated tuples invalidate the claim. Source prefix 3 alone is not enough to label PTE (DDTW differs); source prefix2 alone is not enough to name one DMA descriptor.
minimal_missing_fact.clock_boundary: MIG debt and response order use only destination ui clock. TL owner timestamps use source platform clk. Do not subtract their cycle counters or reuse 50MHz until an actual CDC/time anchor is recorded. Native service ordering has no need for cross-domain elapsed-time subtraction.
errors_and_window: ARM tracking must begin from a known-quiet state before capture/acceptance tracking, with zero or explicitly checked empty native accepted-read ledger, and remain continuous through source/MIG epoch. The later original P4M open may have carry-in reads only if their earlier acceptances were already recorded; do not begin AR tracking at that open.
Keep all L predecessor receipts up through P firstRfire/consumption, even if the old V close occurs; do not reset/drain counters at open/close.

Reject truncation/overflow/counter wrap, unmatched/duplicate response, wrong RID occurrence, early/late/missing RLAST or beat-length mismatch, invalid classification, reset/calibration epoch change, response errors or aborted record.
Separate RVALID&&!RREADY hold from intervals with no RVALID; a held L last beat proves output backpressure, not native bank conflict.
Use a naturally reached normal PN episode and fixed existing workload; do not manufacture larger burst/FIFO fullness, delay, phase scan, more walkers/capacity/pressure.

Save fixed-window open/close coverage, total eligible PTE opportunities, selected ordinal and explicit no-PTE/no-capture/error reason; event loss or counter overflow invalidates the record. Do not use a D>0-only triggered record as a workload distribution.

decision_role.positive: k>0 and valid owner association establish a real front-of-PTE accepted payload debt opportunity in the bound implementation, and which upstream commitment preceded P. They do not explain the entire 0.90M-cycle difference.
decision_role.negative: K=0/P before L rejects this selected episode's positive predecessor-debt explanation only. Complete fixed-window eligible-PTE count and no-record reason distinguish no eligible PTE from capture loss/errors; neither one episode nor a D>0-only trigger proves a distribution or problem absence.
decision_role.scope_limit: The record does not prove unique innovation, a legal two-head source, ordinary-control failure, A/B performance, full-task throughput or engineering-cost advantage. Source semantics already predicts order; observation supplies reachability/actual ownership, not another MIG proof.
decision_role.precommit_requirement: If L was common irreversible debt before the normal TL choice, it cannot be booked as candidate benefit. A candidate needs an actual precommit choice that can change the debt and survives a frozen ordinary control; root-owned later gate.

minimal_missing_fact.workload_selection: Freeze the original legal A8/gap0 PN workload and fixed observation window. Capture the first eligible PTE MIG AR acceptance regardless of K, not the first K>0 event. Keep total eligible PTE opportunity count/selected ordinal over the complete fixed window, plus no-PTE/no-capture/error reason. No new pressure or two-head condition.
